doc: Unguarded degenerate input, float32: the zero vector gives NaN (0/0); 1e30 squares to infinity so the result is 0, not 1; 1e-30 squares to 0 (below the smallest float32 subnormal) so the result is [inf, NaN, NaN]; 1e20 each overflows the sum. These are what the Python does with the naive formula; no caller passes such vectors. Tagged degenerate: a port that guards (hypot, scaling) may differ.
